cards.title: Managing Clothes Power Struggles With Kids
cards.body: A parent questions how to handle a mother-in-law's gift of overly girly clothes for their daughter. The advice explores finding balance between letting children express individuality and graciously accepting gifts.

cards.title: Parental Burnout and Special Needs Parenting
cards.body: Parent burnout affects caregivers of children with special needs in profound ways. Learning to recharge without guilt can help restore relationships and emotional resilience.

cards.title: How to Parent an Adult Child With Schizophrenia
cards.body: A father shares effective strategies for supporting an adult child living with a psychotic disorder. His approach offers practical insights for long-term parental caregiving.

cards.title: A Guide to College Homesickness
cards.body: Homesickness affects many first-year college students and can feel overwhelming. Six practical steps help young adults navigate this common transition challenge.

cards.title: Bearing Children in a Fractured World
cards.body: Parents face timeless questions about bringing children into an uncertain world. Experts explore what sustains hope and meaning in parenting decisions.

cards.title: Emotional Regulation and Emotions Education
cards.body: Children need education in understanding and regulating emotions for healthy development. Without these tools, kids struggle to manage their nervous systems and emotional health.

cards.title: When Defiance Means Something Different
cards.body: A former student challenged understanding of oppositional defiant disorder in children. The experience reframes how educators and parents evaluate difficult behavior.

cards.title: Suburban Life With Young Kids
cards.body: A family discovered that suburban life offered more to enjoy than initially expected. The key was shifting perspective on where to find excitement and community.

cards.title: IKEA Shopping Reveals Parenting Gaps
cards.body: A parent realizes their children lack basic domestic skills during an IKEA outing. The experience reflects how much life wisdom parents actually pass on.

cards.title: Young People Want Families, Need Support
cards.body: Despite falling birthrates, young people still desire partners and children. Governments must address insecurity and isolation preventing family formation.
